name: crlf-target-lf-context
description: WRIT-345 item R4 (spec/resolution.md §Target Tree & Content Preparation, 'CRLF preserves \r'): the target file's lines keep their trailing carriage return exactly as split -- CRLF is not normalized away before line matching. The recorded context carries plain LF line content (no \r), so it cannot exact- or fuzzy-match any line of win.go: every candidate window scores 0, and since anchor.path is present in the target tree (just impossible to match), the side orphans as no-candidate rather than path-absent. A resolver that stripped \r before comparing (spec/resolution.md's Rung 3/4 window matching) would resolve this anchor instead.
